narrative.rotation_signal: Clear accumulation in mega-cap tech (AAPL, MSFT, GOOG, AVGO, AMD, ORCL, NVDA) and defensive staples (WMT, PG, COST, JNJ). Distribution concentrated in money-center banks (JPM, BAC), payments (V), pharma (LLY, ABBV), and energy (CVX) — a barbell of tech + staples against cyclicals and healthcare.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: Semis split: AVGO/AMD/NVDA/INTC strongly bid while KLAC and TXN bearish — suggests selective AI-capex thesis, not blanket semi bull. Financials bifurcated: MS bullish (10 flow) vs JPM/BAC bearish, breaking typical sector cohesion. LLY bearish despite max dark pool/block scores — flow rejecting the tape print.
